originalConcern.scope: out-of-scope choice D text and its translations
originalConcern.assessment: A separate clarification would be appropriate: the Japanese phrase 推論時のレイテンシー不足 and the corresponding insufficient-latency wording are unnatural because latency is not something that is insufficient. A future, separately scoped edit could say 推論時のレイテンシーの問題 and use equivalent natural wording in each locale. No edit was added here because the requested 12 fields are limited to title, prompt, and the two specified explanations in PT, FR, and ES.
